answer: Per-identity bonds are the only cost an attacker cannot script away, 200 POA locked for 30 days, clawed back in full on a replayed submission rather than a fraction. Assume the farm automates everything else. It still needs 20,000 POA parked for 100 seats, and one replay detector freezes the whole set. A mesa of lookalike accounts reads flat until you check the payout ledger, which is the mirror showing whether the bond was earned or recycled. Jade collateral proves nothing here, only the lockup and the clawback count.
